comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The mode and voicing names are read verbatim from Kleztizer::Kleztizer. The pedal jack carries key/12 - 2V and the bass jack the chord root an octave above that, dropping a further octave on the seventh degree. Output 4 is the only polyphonic port in the whole plugin: it is given a channel count and written at voltages[0], [1] and [2], which is what the panel's 1/POLY marking means. Exactly how each mode's degrees and inversions are built was not traced through, so the chord lines stay general.
